adjudication.rationale: The diff shows at line 74 in addGuests.handler.ts: `!blacklistedGuestEmails.includes(guest)` where `blacklistedGuestEmails` is created by `.map((email) => email.toLowerCase())` (line 68-69), but `guest` comes directly from user input without any normalization. This means a guest email like 'Blocked@Example.com' would not match 'blocked@example.com' in the blacklist, allowing the bypass described in the finding. This is a real security bug.
